name: Aluminium Fluoride (AlF3): Smelter Flux Import Substitution from Fertiliser Fluorine By-Product
scope: India's aluminium fluoride (AlF3) supply chain: the smelter build-out driving flux demand, the fertiliser FSA by-product route, and listed makers, entrants and smelter buyers.

summary.one_line: Results week cleared two of three catalysts without AlF3 news. Paradeep's Q2 profit fell 65% on a Rs 60 cr inventory write-down, NALCO's Q2 profit rose 28%, and the NALCO AlF3 EoI closed on 30 Oct with no respondents disclosed. Alufluoride's Q2, the real volume test, is still not scheduled.
key_points: New this week: Paradeep Phosphates' Q2 FY27 (29 Oct). Revenue rose 7.2% year on year to Rs 7,364 cr, while net profit fell about 65% to Rs 121 cr after a Rs 59.98 cr inventory write-down. Subsidy income was booked under the Kharif notification because the Rabi notification had not been issued (S26). We found no AlF3 project update in the results coverage or in the announcements on its screener page (S14)(S26).

New this week: NALCO's board approved Q2 FY27 results on 2 Nov. Standalone profit was Rs 1,835 cr, up 28% year on year but down 8.4% from Rs 2,003 cr in Q1. It declared an interim dividend of Rs 4.50 (record date 6 Nov) and has an analyst call on 3 Nov (S15)(S27). The AlF3 JV/partner EoI closed on 30 Oct (S21). NALCO has filed no update on it, and no respondents have been named (S15).

Smelter demand is arriving. Vedanta Aluminium Metal (VAML), demerged from Vedanta Ltd with effect from 1 May 2026 and now separately listed (S29), had the second zone of BALCO's 435 kt expansion running in Q2 FY27 (S28). BALCO's output rose 19% year on year to 178 kt (S20). At 14-20 kg of AlF3 per tonne of aluminium (S3), the full 435 kt implies about 6-9 kt/yr of extra AlF3 (our arithmetic).

Announced smelter additions total about 1.3 Mtpa: Hindalco Aditya +3.6 lakh tpa (S6), NALCO Angul +0.5 Mtpa by early 2030 (S7)(S23) and BALCO +435 kt (S20). At 14-20 kg/t (S3), that implies roughly 18-26 kt/yr of extra AlF3 (our arithmetic). Announced domestic supply additions are 6 kt at Alufluoride and 15 kt at Paradeep (S1)(S3).

China's benchmark AlF3 tenders for October settled at 12,600-13,000 yuan/t, more than 1,000 yuan/t higher, with high-grade at 12,900-13,300 yuan/t (SMM, 22 Oct) (S22). That compares with 11,500-12,500 yuan/t on 24 Sep (S16). SMM attributes the rise to fluorite costs and low operating rates, and notes some deals done below quoted levels (S22). We found no newer SMM fluoride review.

Alufluoride (24,000 tpa since Jun 2026) saw Q1 FY27 sales fall to Rs 26.6 cr from Rs 43.8 cr on the FSA shortage (S3)(S4). It closed at Rs 543 on 2 Nov, a market cap of Rs 425 cr (S4). As of 2 Nov it had filed no board-meeting date for Q2 results (S4). The Sep-2025 quarter base is Rs 54.8 cr (S4).

FSA, not plant capacity, remains the bottleneck. On its Q1 call, Paradeep cited the Hormuz disruption to sulphur and ammonia and said it ran about 70% of phosphoric capacity (S1). Alufluoride cut operations in May 2026 for the same reason (S5).

for_investors.title: Who benefits
points: Alufluoride is the only listed pure-play, qualified at Hindalco, Vedanta and NALCO (S4), with 24,000 tpa of capacity (S3). BALCO's ramp (S28) and firmer Chinese prices (S22) help, but its volumes depend on FSA supply.

Paradeep Phosphates would convert 9,000-10,000 tpa of low-value FSA into a non-subsidy product (S1). The guided Rs 180-200 cr of revenue is under 1% of TTM sales of Rs 23,939 cr (S1)(S14). Q2's subsidy-timing and inventory hit (S26) shows why management wants non-subsidy earnings.
NALCO and other smelters: a domestic JV or long-term partner would cut reliance on imported AlF3, such as the 2,520 t NALCO tendered for in Jan 2026 (S21).

for_investors.title: Who is hurt / risks
points: Alufluoride buys part of its FSA from Paradeep 'as available' (S3). Paradeep plans to use its own HFSA in-house (S1), so that source likely ends around 2028.
FSA output depends on phosphoric acid run rates, which the 2026 Hormuz disruption to sulphur and ammonia has hit (S1)(S5).
Customer concentration: Alufluoride's largest customer was 69.27% of its FY25 AlF3 revenue (S3).

for_investors.title: What to watch
points: 3 Nov: NALCO's Q2 analyst call (S15). Watch for any shortlist, RFP or timeline for the AlF3 EoI (S21)(S23).
Alufluoride Q2 FY27 results, not yet scheduled (S4). They will show whether volumes recovered, as management expected (S3).
Paradeep's Q2 call and its 2 Nov investor presentation (S14) for AlF3 engineering and ordering progress against the 22-24 month timeline (S1).

sections.title: What AlF3 is and how the fertiliser by-product route works

subsections.title: The product, demand driver and price reference

blocks.text: Aluminium fluoride is added to the cryolite bath in aluminium electrolysis to lower its melting point and improve conductivity (S10). Alufluoride says 14-20 kg of AlF3 is used per tonne of aluminium. It describes the Indian market as supplied by fewer than five domestic makers plus imports, with only a few able to supply the high-purity, low-bulk-density material the major smelters need (S3). AlF3 volumes therefore rise in line with primary aluminium output.

Import data is thin. OEC data for 2022 lists India as the world's second-largest importer of aluminium fluoride, at about USD 82.3 mn (S19). NALCO's Jan 2026 global tender for 2,520 t of low-bulk-density AlF3 is a recent sign of import reliance (S21). Searches this week again found no official 2025-26 import volume and no DGTR or customs action on AlF3 (HS 28261200).

blocks.caption: China AlF3 reference prices (SMM, yuan/t)
rows: October tenders up more than 1,000 yuan/t; tight spot supply, though some deals done lower

blocks.text: China's price rise is cost-driven: fluorite is firm and mine operating rates are low after inspections (S22). It is not a demand boom. Firmer Chinese prices reduce the near-term threat from imports into India, but the rise would reverse if fluorite eases.

subsections.title: The FSA route and its bottleneck

blocks.text: In the wet route, aluminium hydroxide is reacted with hydrofluosilicic acid (FSA/HFSA), the silica is filtered out, and the AlF3 is crystallised and dried (S10). FSA is a by-product of phosphoric acid at phosphate fertiliser plants, so AlF3 supply depends on fertiliser operating rates (S3)(S5).

items: Paradeep Phosphates makes about 9,000-10,000 tpa of FSA and today sells all of it to outside buyers (S1).

Alufluoride's FSA supply: an IFFCO Paradeep contract above 17,500 tpa (expandable to 19,000 tpa), about 4,500 tpa from Coromandel's Visakhapatnam and Kakinada plants, and Paradeep Phosphates 'as available' (S3).
In 2026, West Asia hostilities disrupted sulphur and ammonia supply through Hormuz. Alufluoride scaled back operations in May 2026 (S5), and Paradeep ran about 70% of phosphoric capacity in Q1 (S1).

blocks.text: NALCO's EoI (ref. NALCO/BD/ST/2026/5805) seeks either an equity JV, preferably near the Angul smelter, or a long-term partnership tied to assured offtake. Responses feed a shortlist before a detailed RFP or JV talks (S23). Applicants need AlF3 manufacturing experience and access to feedstock (S23). The deadline was extended from 12 Oct to 30 Oct (S21). NALCO's 2 Nov results filings do not mention it (S15).

On paper, new supply (+6 kt at Alufluoride, +15 kt at Paradeep) roughly matches the 18-26 kt of implied new demand. But both depend on FSA from the same few east-coast phosphoric acid plants (S1)(S3), so feedstock, not plant capacity, is the binding limit.

In FY25, Alufluoride produced a record 16,377 t and dispatched 15,831 t (S3). Q1 FY27 sales fell 39.3% year on year to Rs 26.6 cr on the FSA disruption. TTM sales are Rs 192 cr and PAT Rs 25 cr, with ROCE of 24% and debt/equity of 0.36 (S4). Its shares were admitted to NSE trading on 17 Aug 2026 (S4). The largest customer was 69.27% of FY25 AlF3 revenue (S3). Its only filing in the past four weeks is a 13 Oct compliance certificate, and no Q2 board meeting has been announced (S4).

SPIC makes 'Greenstar' ALF-96 AlF3 by the FSA-alumina hydrate route. Its named customers are Hindalco, Dubal, Stella and Foundry Service (S10). It does not disclose AlF3 capacity or revenue, and it is mainly a urea maker with TTM sales of Rs 3,024 cr (S11). Tanfac lists AlF3 among its HF-derived products (S12). Its Rs 495 cr expansion is mainly a Rs 405 cr, 20,000 t HFC-32 plant (S13). Neither discloses AlF3 as a material earnings line.

Paradeep's Q2 FY27 profit fell to Rs 121 cr from Rs 342 cr, after a Rs 59.98 cr write-down to net realisable value. Expenses grew faster than revenue, and subsidy income was booked at Kharif rates pending the Rabi notification (S26). H1 FY27 revenue was Rs 13,488 cr (+18.6%) and profit Rs 514 cr (-22%) (S26). Guidance for the AlF3 plant is Rs 180-200 cr revenue on 15,000 t, which implies about Rs 1.2-1.33 lakh/t (our arithmetic from S1). That is close to Alufluoride's FY25 blended revenue of about Rs 1.19 lakh per tonne dispatched (our arithmetic from S3 and S4). Management targets at least 20% of EBITDA from non-subsidy businesses over time (S1).

Coromandel supplies about 4,500 tpa of FSA to Alufluoride (S3) and has announced no AlF3 plant (market cap about Rs 50,035 cr) (S25). NALCO's Q2 standalone profit of Rs 1,835 cr (S27) and market cap of about Rs 60,242 cr (S15) mean an AlF3 JV would be about supply security, not earnings (S23). VAML, with a market cap of about Rs 1.41 lakh cr (S29), has announced no captive AlF3 plan.

sections.title: Research house views and market positioning

items: We again found no broker or mainstream media report grouping these stocks as an 'AlF3 theme'. Trade press (SMM, AlCircle) covers the NALCO EoI, while results coverage of Paradeep this week focused on the profit fall and did not mention AlF3 (S21)(S23)(S26).

Paradeep rose 14.54% intraday to Rs 159.50 on 29 Jul 2026 on Q1 results and the AlF3 approval (S2). It closed at Rs 135 on 2 Nov, up 4.55% on the day (S14), and is 28.7% below its 52-week high as of 2 Nov (numbers.json, screener). The post-announcement gain has fully reversed.
Alufluoride closed at Rs 543 on 2 Nov, down 3.07% on the day, against a high of Rs 701 (S4). It has traded sideways for three weeks with no news and Q2 results pending.
NALCO closed at Rs 328 on 2 Nov, on the day of its results (S15).

On Paradeep's Q1 FY27 call, analysts from Elara Securities, Aequitas, HDFC AMC and others asked about AlF3 timing, realisation and grade. Management said the plant targets Odisha smelters and needs no qualification period (S1). This is management's view, not independently verified.

blocks.caption: Valuation snapshot (screener.in via numbers.json, as of 2 Nov 2026 pre-market; VAML from screener page, 2 Nov close)

items: FSA shortage: Alufluoride's Q1 FY27 sales fell 39% year on year when the West Asia disruption cut feedstock (S4)(S5).
Supplier turning competitor: Paradeep supplies FSA to Alufluoride (S3) but plans to use its own HFSA in-house (S1).

Entrant balance-sheet strain: Paradeep's Q2 profit fell 65%, with an inventory write-down and delayed Rabi subsidy rates (S26), and debt/equity is about 1.0 (numbers.json, screener). That could compete with AlF3 capex for attention.
Price: China's rise is cost-driven (S22). If fluorite eases, Chinese AlF3 and imports could get cheaper.
Concentration: Alufluoride's top customer was 69% of FY25 AlF3 revenue (S3), and demand is tied to three smelter groups (S4).
Project slippage: NALCO's new smelter targets early 2030 (S7), and its AlF3 EoI deadline was extended once (S21). Hindalco has disclosed no Aditya commissioning date (S6).
Liquidity: Alufluoride's market cap is about Rs 425 cr (S4).

companies.name: Alufluoride Ltd
companies.role: India's largest maker of low-bulk-density AlF3, qualified at Hindalco, Vedanta and NALCO (S4). It converts fertiliser FSA into AlF3 at Visakhapatnam, with 24,000 tpa installed (S3).
companies.impact: The most direct play on smelter growth such as BALCO's ramp (S28) and on firmer China prices (S22), but constrained by FSA supply. Q1 FY27 sales were Rs 26.6 cr against Rs 43.8 cr a year earlier, and Q2 results are not yet scheduled (S4). A natural candidate for NALCO's EoI, though no respondents have been disclosed (S21).

companies.name: Southern Petrochemicals Industries Corporation (SPIC)
companies.role: Makes Greenstar ALF-96 AlF3 by the FSA route and supplies Hindalco, Dubal and others (S10). Mainly a urea maker (S11).
companies.impact: AlF3 capacity and revenue are undisclosed. Against TTM sales of Rs 3,024 cr (S11), it is unlikely to be a meaningful earnings driver on current evidence.

companies.name: Tanfac Industries Ltd
companies.role: HF-based fluorochemicals maker whose products include aluminium fluoride (S12).
companies.impact: Growth comes from HF and a Rs 405 cr HFC-32 plant (S13), not AlF3. At about 111x earnings (S12), the AlF3 theme is marginal for the stock.

companies.name: Paradeep Phosphates Ltd
companies.role: DAP/NPK maker producing 9,000-10,000 tpa of FSA. It is building a Rs 250 cr, 15,000 tpa AlF3 plant (S1)(S2).
companies.impact: Guided Rs 180-200 cr revenue and at least Rs 50 cr EBITDA after a 22-24 month build (S1), under 1% of TTM sales of Rs 23,939 cr (S14). Q2 FY27 profit fell 65% to Rs 121 cr on an inventory write-down and subsidy timing, with no AlF3 update found (S26).

companies.name: Coromandel International Ltd
companies.role: Supplies about 4,500 tpa of FSA to Alufluoride from its Visakhapatnam and Kakinada phosphoric acid plants (S3).
companies.impact: An FSA supplier only, with no AlF3 plant announced. At a market cap of about Rs 50,035 cr (S25), AlF3 would be immaterial.

companies.name: National Aluminium Company Ltd (NALCO)
companies.role: Smelter expanding Angul to about 0.96 Mtpa by early 2030 (S7)(S23). Sought AlF3 JV or partnership proposals through an EoI that closed on 30 Oct 2026 (S21).
companies.impact: The aim is supply security rather than earnings: Q2 FY27 standalone profit was Rs 1,835 cr and the interim dividend Rs 4.50 (S27)(S15). The EoI outcome is undisclosed (S15).

companies.name: Hindalco Industries Ltd
companies.role: Buys AlF3 from Alufluoride and SPIC (S4)(S10). Adding a 3.6 lakh tpa smelter at Aditya (S6).
companies.impact: Implies about 5-7 kt/yr of extra AlF3 demand (our arithmetic on S3 and S6). No captive AlF3 plan or commissioning date found.

companies.name: Vedanta Aluminium Metal Ltd (VAML)
companies.role: Vedanta's aluminium business, demerged with effect from 1 May 2026 and separately listed (S29). An AlF3 customer of Alufluoride (S4), it is running the BALCO 435 kt expansion, now on its second zone (S28).
companies.impact: The nearest-term demand addition. BALCO output rose 19% year on year to 178 kt in Q2 FY27 (S20), with full ramp targeted by Q4 FY27 (S17). No captive AlF3 plan found.

companies.name: Vedanta Ltd
companies.role: Former parent of the aluminium business. Its shareholders received VAML shares 1:1 in the demerger (S29).
companies.impact: After the demerger, smelter-driven AlF3 demand sits with VAML (S29). We keep Vedanta Ltd only for continuity with earlier editions.

method: Weekly refresh of the 2026-W44 edition, researched on 3 Nov 2026 using web search and direct page fetches. New this week: (1) Paradeep's Q2 FY27 results (29 Oct) from Free Press Journal (S26), cross-checked against the screener results table and announcement list (S14). Neither mentions AlF3; the 2 Nov investor presentation itself was not reviewed. (2) NALCO's 2 Nov board outcome: an interim dividend of Rs 4.50 and a 3 Nov analyst call from the screener announcements (S15), plus Q2 profit from Multibagg (S27). We found no primary press release, and revenue was not confirmed. NALCO has filed nothing on the AlF3 EoI, which closed on 30 Oct (S21). (3) Vedanta's aluminium business demerged into Vedanta Aluminium Metal Ltd (NSE: VAML), effective 1 May 2026 (S29). VAML replaces Vedanta Ltd as the smelter company; Vedanta Ltd is kept under 'other' for continuity. (4) We re-fetched the SMM 22 Oct review (S22) and found no newer fluoride review. Dropped as stale: WebIndia123 (NALCO 2025 plan, superseded by S7 and S23), the PSU Connect EoI and board-meeting notices (superseded by S21 and S15), and the Angel One Paradeep Odisha MoU item, which has no AlF3 link. Source IDs from last week are kept unchanged, so there are gaps in the numbering. The valuation table uses numbers.json (screener.in, as of 2 Nov 2026 pre-market), except VAML, which comes from its screener page. Closing prices for 2 Nov come from the fetched screener pages. Searches for DGTR or customs action on AlF3 again found none. Facts from company documents (S1, S3, S6, S10) are unchanged disclosures and were not re-fetched. Implied AlF3 demand and realisation figures are our own arithmetic and labelled as such. Market-cap coverage: small caps (Alufluoride, SPIC), mid caps (Tanfac, Paradeep) and large caps (Coromandel, NALCO, Hindalco, VAML). Earlier searches for AlF3 plans at FACT, GSFC, Gujarat Fluorochemicals and Navin Fluorine found nothing qualifying, so the listed pure-play universe is effectively one small cap. Not verified: NALCO EoI respondents, AlF3 revenue shares at SPIC and Tanfac, Hindalco's Aditya commissioning date, India's 2025-26 import volumes, and the brief's six-month and one-year return figures. No ratings or price targets.
